test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 14 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: In January 2022, who was appointed as the Chief Economic Advisor (CEA) of the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venkatraman Anantha Nageswaran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Venkatramanan Anantha Nageswaran** is an Indian economist and the country's** 18th Chief Economic Advisor**.
 
• Between 2019 and 2021, he served as a part-time member of the Economic Advisory Council after receiving his doctorate in finance from the University of Massachusetts Amherst for his work on the empirical behaviour of exchange rates.
 
• He has also served as a visiting professor at Andhra Pradesh's Krea University, as well as a graduate student-professor at Singapore Management University and the Indian Institutes of Management Bangalore and Indore.
 
• He was appointed Chief Economic Advisor of the Government of India on January 28, 2022, succeeding **Krishnamurthy Subramanian, who served a three-year term that ended in December 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Rajiv Kumar **is an Indian economist who previously served as the NITI Aayog's second vice-chairman.
 
• **Arvind Subramanian **is an Indian economist who served as the Government of India's Chief Economic Advisor from 16 October 2014 to 20 June 2018. 
 
• **Krishnamurthy Venkata Subramanian **is an Indian economist and former Chief Economic Adviser to the Government of India (CEA). He was appointed to the role on December 7, 2018, and left on October 8, 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The post of** Chief Economic Adviser (CEA)** is comparable to that of Secretary to the Government of India in the Indian government.
 
• The CEA is the Indian Economic Service's ex-officio cadre controlling authority.
 
• The CEA is the head of the Economic Division of the Ministry of Finance's Department of Economic Affairs.
